description: This file defines a custom exception class 'DividentProcessingException' used within the share products portfolio module of the Fineract core banking platform. It extends an abstract exception class and is used for signaling errors related to dividend processing.

classes.name: DividentProcessingException
classes.description: A custom exception used for handling dividend processing errors within the share products module.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message code and a default user message, preparing a specific error message for dividend processing issues.
